text: Based on the data from NASA FIRMS, there were no fire detections intersecting the asset ASSET-F02 during the period from September 25, 2026, to October 25, 2026. The sensors VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS covered the asset for most of this period, with the last day not covered due to the latest near real-time (NRT) file update. Therefore, it can be concluded that there was no fire on the asset during the evaluated period.
